name: Tor
greeting: Leave the peg proud. Someone will need to pull it out when the next flood comes.
lines: Kael: You expect it to fail?
Tor: I expect someone to repair it. A thing can be well made without being the last thing anyone ever makes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Water threads through the cleared drain. Rook's empty wheel crosses the boards without sinking.

lines: Tor: There. A road ought to carry the person using it. Start with that.
